unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U19: Map advisory councils,CCPA,commissions and dated monetary jurisdiction

payload.title: The similar institution names describe different functions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Consumer Protection Councils advise on promoting and protecting rights. CCPA has the described class-protection, investigation and enforcement functions. The District, State and National Commissions decide the complaints and appeals assigned to them. An advisory meeting is not a substitute for an adjudicatory order.

For ordinary complaint jurisdiction under the 2021 rules reproduced in the chapter, use consideration paid: District up to INR 50 lakh, State above INR 50 lakh up to INR 2 crore, National above INR 2 crore. Do not substitute compensation demanded, copy older original-Act figures, or apply these ordinary limits mechanically to the separate unfair-contract jurisdiction. Territorial grounds and later changes also need checking.

self_check.prompt_text: Does compensation demanded automatically determine ordinary pecuniary jurisdiction under the stated rules?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The stated basis is consideration paid.

payload.stem_md: Under the expressly stipulated2021 ordinary-complaint rules, consideration paid is INR 4,800,000 but compensation sought is much higher. Which amount is the stated monetary basis?

options.text_md: The highest figure mentioned anywhere in the complaint
options.explanation_md: That is not the prescribed measure.
Legal fees do not establish consideration paid.
Institution size is not the complaint value basis.

options.text_md: The consideration paid, subject to the relevant complaint category and other conditions
options.explanation_md: The ordinary monetary rule uses this defined basis.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The ordinary monetary rule uses this defined basis.

options.text_md: All bodies with consumer in their name have identical powers

options.explanation_md: Council existence does not replace the appellate framework.
